# Muhammad Hamid

**AI Automation Engineer · Python Developer · AI Agent & MCP Builder**

I build agentic systems that survive contact with production: tool-using agents with explicit permission gates, evaluation suites, traces and cost controls — then wire them into real stacks via APIs, webhooks and MCP servers.

Based in Lahore, Pakistan · Portfolio: [marvis.web.app](https://marvis.web.app/)

---

## What I build

- **AI agents with governance** — tool permissions, approval steps, execution traces, cost ceilings, and eval harnesses that measure accuracy before anything ships.
- **MCP servers and integrations** — Model Context Protocol servers that expose real business systems (commerce, analytics, search data) to Claude, Cursor, VS Code and Codex.
- **Python automation** — FastAPI services, scheduled pipelines and CLI tools that replace manual recurring work.
- **Technical SEO & marketing automation** — crawlers, audit engines and conversion-tracking diagnostics that turn marketing data into deterministic fixes.
